name: PV_Add
description: Complex addition of two FFT chains. Sums real and imaginary parts of bufferA and bufferB.

inputs.name: bufferA
inputs.description: FFT chain A (also receives the result)

name: PV_Copy
description: Copies the spectral frame from bufferA into bufferB. Allows parallel processing of FFT data without multiple FFT UGens. Both buffers must be the same size.

inputs.name: bufferB
inputs.description: Destination FFT chain (must match bufferA size)

name: PV_CopyPhase
description: Combines magnitudes from bufferA with phases from bufferB.

name: PV_Conj
description: Complex conjugate. Reverses the sign of the imaginary part of each bin. Component for analysis or transformation processes.

name: PV_Div
description: Complex division of two FFT chains. Useful for transfer-function estimation by dividing output spectrum by input spectrum.

inputs.name: bufferA
inputs.description: FFT chain A (numerator, also receives the result)

name: PV_Max
description: Output copies bins with the maximum magnitude of the two FFT chains.

inputs.name: bufferA
inputs.description: FFT chain A (also receives the result)

name: PV_Min
description: Output copies bins with the minimum magnitude of the two FFT chains.

inputs.name: bufferA
inputs.description: FFT chain A (also receives the result)

name: PV_Mul
description: Complex multiplication of two FFT chains. Multiplies (RealA*RealB - ImagA*ImagB, ImagA*RealB + RealA*ImagB) per bin.

inputs.name: bufferA
inputs.description: FFT chain A (also receives the result)

name: PV_MagAbove
description: Pass only bins whose magnitude is above a threshold; zero the rest.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: Magnitude threshold; bins at or below this are zeroed

name: PV_MagBelow
description: Pass only bins whose magnitude is below a threshold; zero the rest.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: Magnitude threshold; bins at or above this are zeroed

name: PV_MagClip
description: Clip bin magnitudes to a maximum threshold.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: Maximum magnitude; larger values are clamped down to this

name: PV_MagDiv
description: Divides magnitudes of bufferA by magnitudes of bufferB while keeping phases of bufferA.

inputs.name: bufferA
inputs.description: FFT chain A (numerator, also receives the result)

inputs.name: zeroed
inputs.description: Replacement value when bufferB bins are zero (avoids divide-by-zero)

name: PV_MagMul
description: Multiplies magnitudes of bufferA by magnitudes of bufferB; keeps phases of bufferA.

inputs.name: bufferA
inputs.description: FFT chain A (also receives the result)

name: PV_MagSquared
description: Squares the magnitudes of all bins, then renormalises to the previous peak. Makes weak bins weaker.

name: PV_MagFreeze
description: Freezes magnitudes at their current values when freeze > 0; magnitudes update normally otherwise.

inputs.name: freeze
inputs.description: If > 0, magnitudes are frozen at their current levels

name: PV_MagShift
description: Shift and stretch the positions of bin magnitudes (phases unchanged). Crude frequency shifter/scaler.

inputs.name: stretch
inputs.description: Multiplicative factor on bin index (>1 stretches up)

name: PV_MagSmear
description: Average a bin's magnitude with its neighbors. Higher 'bins' values raise CPU usage.

inputs.name: bins
inputs.description: Number of neighbouring bins on each side to include in the average

name: PV_MagNoise
description: Multiplies bin magnitudes by white noise.

name: PV_BinScramble
description: Randomises the order of FFT bins. The trigger picks a new random ordering.

inputs.name: wipe
inputs.description: Scrambles more bins as wipe moves from 0 to 1

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Maximum randomised distance of a bin from its original location, in [0, 1]

inputs.name: trig
inputs.description: Trigger that selects a new random ordering

name: PV_BinShift
description: Shift and stretch the positions of FFT bins (magnitude and phase together). Crude frequency shifter/scaler.

inputs.name: interp
inputs.description: 0 = no interpolation, 1 = linear interpolation between bins

name: PV_BinWipe
description: Combine low bins from one FFT chain and high bins from the other. wipe selects the crossover point.

inputs.name: bufferA
inputs.description: FFT chain A (also receives the result)

inputs.name: wipe
inputs.description: Crossover position in [-1, 1]; 0 = all A, >0 fills from bottom up with B, <0 from top down

name: PV_BrickWall
description: Zero bins above or below a cutoff. wipe > 0 acts like high-pass (clears from bottom up); wipe < 0 acts like low-pass (clears from top down).

name: PV_LocalMax
description: Pass only bins whose magnitude is above a threshold and above their nearest neighbours.

name: PV_Diffuser
description: Adds a different constant random phase shift to each bin. The trigger picks a new set of random phases.

inputs.name: trig
inputs.description: Trigger that selects a new set of random phases

name: PV_RandComb
description: Randomly clear bins. wipe selects how many are cleared; the trigger picks a new random ordering.

inputs.name: wipe
inputs.description: Clears more bins in a random order as wipe moves from 0 to 1

inputs.name: trig
inputs.description: Trigger that selects a new random ordering

name: PV_RandWipe
description: Crossfades between two FFT chains by copying bins of bufferB into bufferA in a random order.

inputs.name: bufferA
inputs.description: FFT chain A (also receives the result)

inputs.name: wipe
inputs.description: Copies more bins from bufferB as wipe moves from 0 to 1

inputs.name: trig
inputs.description: Trigger that selects a new random ordering

name: PV_RectComb
description: Make a series of gaps in the spectrum (rectangular comb).

inputs.name: numTeeth
inputs.description: Number of teeth in the comb

inputs.name: phase
inputs.description: Starting phase of the comb pulse

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Pulse width of the comb in [0, 1]

name: PV_RectComb2
description: Alternates blocks of bins between two FFT chains (rectangular comb of two inputs).

inputs.name: bufferA
inputs.description: FFT chain A (also receives the result)

inputs.name: numTeeth
inputs.description: Number of teeth in the comb

inputs.name: phase
inputs.description: Starting phase of the comb pulse

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Pulse width of the comb in [0, 1]

name: PV_PhaseShift
description: Shift the phase of all bins by a given amount, optionally accumulating across calls.

inputs.name: integrate
inputs.description: If > 0, integrate the phase shift across calls (accumulating shift)

name: PV_PhaseShift90
description: Shift phase of all bins by 90 degrees.

name: PV_PhaseShift270
description: Shift phase of all bins by 270 degrees.

name: PV_ConformalMap
description: Applies the conformal mapping z -> (z - a) / (1 - z*conj(a)) to the phase vocoder bins, where a = areal + i*aimag. Usually keep |a| < 1; large values produce noisy artifacts.
